reason: Four audit findings in the Core follow-up queue and the handoff service. (8) A follow-up drainer that lost the dispatch race to an operator's direct Send got ChatHistoryConflict from prepare_async, which the generic handler treated as a dispatch failure: the item went needs_review, the queue paused and a failure diagnostic was recorded for what was merely a busy conversation. step() now catches ChatHistoryConflict, checks whether a turn the drainer did not start now occupies the session, and if so returns the claim to queued without pausing so a later poll dispatches it once the direct response settles; a genuine history conflict still parks the item for review. (12) A claiming item whose review write lost a revision race stayed claiming forever because the non-recovering step returned on any claiming item and remove/clear refused it. The service now tracks in-flight claim ids; a claiming item nobody is dispatching is reviewed on the next poll, and remove/clear cancel it, while a claim being dispatched is still protected. (14) The startup pass reviewed a sending item whose turn was parked in waiting_callback as 'Delivery is uncertain' and that review never cleared when the results webhook finished the turn. waiting_callback is now treated like waiting_approval, and the reconcile pass marks a needs_review item complete once its turn completes. (21) HandoffService.list could not page and returned oldest first, and expire-on-read used a revision guard so two concurrent GETs of a just-expired envelope turned one into a 409. list now pages newest first with offset/limit (the route gained an offset query parameter), and _expire returns the stored row when a concurrent writer already moved the envelope out of PENDING. Tests: test_follow_up_losing_a_race_to_a_direct_send_waits_instead_of_parking, test_orphaned_claim_is_reviewed_on_the_next_poll_without_a_restart, test_stuck_claim_can_be_removed_or_cleared_but_not_while_dispatching, the new waiting_callback case of test_restart_after_durable_turn_creation_reconciles_without_replay, test_saved_uncertain_review_is_reconciled_when_its_turn_completes, test_handoff_list_pages_newest_first and test_expire_on_read_survives_a_concurrent_expiry each fail on main and pass here; the existing queue and handoff tests still pass.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: src/nebula/v3/api.py matches area:core-api, but the only route change is an additive offset query parameter on GET /handoffs whose default keeps the existing behaviour, and test_handoff_list_pages_newest_first drives that route through TestClient; the real-Core journey suite does not exercise the follow-up queue's dispatch race, orphaned claims or handoff expiry, which the Python tests drive directly against ChatQueueService and HandoffService. No full suites.
